meaning: variant field/source/population QA, not model evaluation or original-question certification

variant_source_qa.reference_query: MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc) WHERE 'R2-2508373' IN t.tdocNumber MATCH (r)-[:MADE_AT]->(m:Meeting) RETURN DISTINCT r.resolutionId AS resolutionId,m.canonicalMeetingNumber AS meetingNumber

MATCH (r:Resolution)-[:REFERENCES]->(t:Tdoc)-[:RELATED_TO]->(wi:WorkItem), (t)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company) WITH wi,c,count(DISTINCT r) AS cnt ORDER BY wi.workItemCode,cnt DESC,c.companyName ASC WITH wi,collect({company:c.companyName,count:cnt})[0..5] AS topCompanies RETURN wi.workItemCode AS workItemCode,topCompanies ORDER BY workItemCode LIMIT 5
MATCH (s:Section)-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]->(sp:Spec {specNumber:'38.331'}) RETURN DISTINCT s.sectionId AS sectionId,s.sectionNumber AS sectionNumber,s.sectionTitle AS sectionTitle
MATCH (cr:CR)-[:SUBMITTED_BY]->(c:Company {companyName:'Huawei'}), (cr)-[:MODIFIES]->(sp:Spec) RETURN sp.specNumber AS specNumber,count(DISTINCT cr) AS crs

MATCH (hub:Spec)<-[:MODIFIES]-(cr:CR) WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL WITH hub,count(DISTINCT cr) AS crCnt MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub) WITH hub,crCnt,rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC,rk.id ASC WITH hub,crCnt,collect(rk)[0] AS latestRk MATCH (latestRk)<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section) WITH hub,crCnt,count(DISTINCT s) AS secCnt WHERE secCnt>0 RETURN hub.specNumber AS specNumber,crCnt,secCnt,round(1.0*crCnt/secCnt,2) AS density

MATCH (n) UNWIND [l IN labels(n) WHERE l IN ['RRCParameter','CapabilityItem','Procedure','PerformanceRequirement','ConformanceTest']] AS class RETURN class,coalesce(n.granularity,'<unset>') AS granularity,count(n) AS count
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport {trNumber:'38.825'})-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact)-[:IMPACTS_SPEC]->(s:Spec) RETURN DISTINCT s.specNumber AS specNumber,imp.impactType AS impactType
MATCH (tr:TechnicalReport)-[:HAS_TR_IMPACT]->(imp:TRImpact) WHERE imp.impactType='ExtendSection' RETURN DISTINCT tr.trNumber AS trNumber
